newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MAZHEIKIU NAFTA TO JOIN BOURSE'S A GROUP.
newsitem.headline: MAZHEIKIU NAFTA TO JOIN BOURSE'S A GROUP.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that its board decided to move the shares of the Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery from its B group to the A group from August 25.

"The board decided to move 58.073 million shares with a face value of ten litas each from the B group to the A group," the head of the stock exchange's listing department, Saulius Malinauskas, told Reuters.
The A group of the Vilnius bourse traces the most active stocks and currently includes 45 securities of companies and banks.
"The total face value of Mazheikiu Nafta securities listed on the A group will be 580 million litas," Malinauskas said.
He said that the bourse wanted to increase the liquidity of the A group and Mazheikiu Nafta was actively traded this year.
"There were 471 deals registered with the company's shares during the first seven months of the year," Malinauskas said.
The company also reported to the bourse that it had 17.7 million litas net profit for the first half of 1997, Malinauskas added.
Mazheikiu Nafta has been slated for privatisation and the tender for lead advisor was launched earlier this month.
